import MumfordLib.SingularAffineSimplex

/-!
# Chains on ordered vertex lists

The simplicial set of all ordered vertex lists has the usual deletion boundary.
Prepending a fixed vertex defines a cone, whose boundary contracts positive
cycles. Lists of points in a standard simplex map to actual singular chains by
affine parametrization. This provides the chain algebra for subdivision.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- The simplicial set with an `n`-simplex for every ordered list of `n + 1`
vertices, including repetitions. -/
def vertexListSSet (V : Type) : SSet where
  obj n := Fin (n.unop.len + 1) → V
  map f := ↾fun v => v ∘ f.unop.toOrderHom

/-- Integral chains on ordered vertex lists. -/
abbrev VertexListChainComplex (V : Type) : ChainComplex (ModuleCat ℤ) ℕ :=
  (vertexListSSet V).chainComplex (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)

variable {V : Type} {n : ℕ}

/-- The chain generator associated to an ordered list. -/
def vertexListChain (v : Fin (n + 1) → V) :
    ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ (VertexListChainComplex V).X n :=
  (vertexListSSet V).ιChainComplex v

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem vertexListChain_boundary (v : Fin (n + 2) → V) :
    vertexListChain v ≫ (VertexListChainComplex V).d (n + 1) n =
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val • vertexListChain (v ∘ i.succAbove) :=
  SSet.ιChainComplex_d _ _ _

/-- Prepend the cone vertex and extend linearly to chains. -/
def vertexListCone (b : V) (n : ℕ) :
    (VertexListChainComplex V).X n ⟶ (VertexListChainComplex V).X (n + 1) :=
  Sigma.desc fun v => vertexListChain (Fin.cons b v)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem vertexListChain_cone (b : V) (v : Fin (n + 1) → V) :
    vertexListChain v ≫ vertexListCone b n = vertexListChain (Fin.cons b v) :=
  Sigma.ι_desc _ _

/-- The cone boundary identity in positive base degree. -/
theorem vertexListCone_boundary (b : V) (n : ℕ) :
    vertexListCone b (n + 1) ≫ (VertexListChainComplex V).d (n + 2) (n + 1) =
      𝟙 _ - (VertexListChainComplex V).d (n + 1) n ≫ vertexListCone b n := by
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro v
  change vertexListChain v ≫ _ = vertexListChain v ≫ _
  have hface (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
      Fin.cons b v ∘ i.succ.succAbove = Fin.cons b (v ∘ i.succAbove) := by
    funext j
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j <;> simp [Fin.succ_succAbove_succ]
  rw [vertexListChain_cone_assoc, vertexListChain_boundary, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  have hzero : Fin.cons b v ∘ (0 : Fin (n + 3)).succAbove = v := by
    funext j
    simp
  simp only [hface, hzero, Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_smul, Fin.val_succ,
    pow_succ, mul_neg_one, neg_smul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
    Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.comp_id]
  rw [← Category.assoc, vertexListChain_boundary]
  simp only [Preadditive.sum_comp, Preadditive.zsmul_comp, vertexListChain_cone,
    sub_eq_add_neg]

/-- Affine parametrization of vertex lists as a simplicial map. -/
def affineVertexListMap (m : ℕ) :
    vertexListSSet (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) ⟶
      TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))) where
  app n := ↾fun v => affineSingularSimplex v
  naturality := by
    intro i j f
    ext v
    apply ((TopCat.of (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).toSSetObjEquiv j).injective
    ext t : 1
    exact (affineSimplexMap_map v f.unop.toOrderHom t).symm

/-- Vertex-list chains map to the actual integral singular chain complex. -/
def affineVertexListChainMap (m : ℕ) :
    VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) ⟶
      IntegralSingularChainComplex (TopCat.of (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))) :=
  SSet.chainComplexMap (affineVertexListMap m) (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem vertexListChain_affineVertexListChainMap {m : ℕ}
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) :
    vertexListChain v ≫ (affineVertexListChainMap m).f n =
      singularSimplexChain (affineSingularSimplex v) :=
  SSet.ι_chainComplexMap_f _ _ _ _ _

end Mumford.Analytic
